subject: Re: Private control plane - SSO/SCIM operator delegation roadmap
messages:
From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@enterprisebank.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: acme-sec@enterprisebank.com
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Private CP operator delegation - initial mapping request

Sergio, Marissa,

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday. Our security team asked us to provide a detailed mapping of the operator roles we need in the private control plane and how those map to our SAML assertions and SCIM groups. Attached is the template they asked us to use (operator-mapping-template.xlsx).

Two quick asks:
- Can Redwood accept a SCIM push that creates both operator groups and service accounts, or do we need a separate provision step for service accounts?
- We need a recommended SAML attribute contract for the operator assertion so our IdP team can hand off a config bundle to us.

I'll loop in our SRE lead for the specific entitlements if useful.

Thanks,
Tom Ellis
Principal SRE, EnterpriseBank
acme-sec@enterprisebank.com

Attachment: operator-mapping-template.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@enterprisebank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 08:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private CP operator delegation - initial mapping request

Tom,

Appreciate the template. Short answers first: yes, we can support SCIM group provisioning that creates operator groups and optionally service accounts, but our recommended pattern is to provision groups and use delegated operator role bindings tied to groups rather than creating a large set of managed service accounts from SCIM. That gives you clearer audit trails and lets you rotate service credentials on your side.

SAML attribute contract recommendations (high level):
- NameID: persistent, e.g., email or stable UUID
- eduPersonAffiliation or role: one of operator_admin, operator_writer, operator_reader
- groups: list of SCIM group names (if possible)
- email_verified: boolean

What I'll do:
1) Marissa and I will draft a mapping from your template to Redwood role bindings and prepare a sample SAML attribute map and IdP metadata snippet.
2) Jordan will validate the SCIM push shape and recommend whether to use bulk provisioning or incremental deltas.
3) We'll produce a short runbook for cutover that includes fallback steps and required auditing events.

Goal: deliver the mapping, SAML contract, and cutover runbook by Nov 19 so you can schedule the IdP change the week of Nov 22.

Sergio
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:26:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private CP operator delegation - initial mapping request

Team,

Quick sync notes from the scoping call with EnterpriseBank on 11/10:
- They prefer group-first provisioning. SCIM will own groups; service accounts will be created by their platform team as needed.
- Required operator roles: operator_admin (full operator), operator_ops (day-to-day), operator_observer (read-only). We should map these to RBAC roles in the control plane and provide an example policy blob.
- Constraints: their IdP only emits groups as CN strings and a single role attribute; we need to support a mapping config that can split/translate role values.

Action items assigned:
- Sergio: draft SAML attribute contract and sample IdP metadata bundle (deadline 2026-11-12).
- Jordan: review SCIM patch semantics and provide recommended batch sizes and retry behavior (deadline 2026-11-15).
- Mina: prepare the audit events spec we'll require from their side for compliance (deadline 2026-11-16).

I attached a quick diagram of the proposed flow. Also adding a note: during cutover, we will gate on a successful reconciliation run that shows identical group membership for a sample of 50 operator users.

Attachment: acme-ssoconfig-diagram.png (png)

Marissa
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@enterprisebank.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Nov 2026 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private CP operator delegation - initial mapping request

Tom,

We reviewed the template and ran a quick test against our SCIM sandbox. Summary and concrete recommendations:

1) SCIM semantics
- Use incremental patch operations for day-to-day changes (Operations: add, remove, replace). Bulk imports are supported but should be used for initial seeding only.
- We surface a 409 conflict when a push tries to create a service account that collides with an existing managed account. Our recommended pattern is to have your platform create service accounts, and SCIM create only groups.

2) Recommended request/timeout settings for your IdP
- Batch size: 250 group-membership entries per PATCH request
- Retry: exponential backoff up to 5 retries
- Timeout: 30s for SCIM calls to our endpoint (we can increase for private CP if you control the network)

3) SAML attribute map (sample)
- name_id -> persistent email
- role -> map to {operator_admin, operator_ops, operator_observer} via claim translation
- groups -> SCIM group names (prefer prefixed groups: rb-operator-*)

4) Cutover checklist highlights
- Run reconciliation across a 50-user sample and verify event audit line items for group assignment changes
- Have a rollback window of 2 hours where we stop processing SCIM deltas and revert to read-only mode if discrepancies found

Next steps: Sergio will send the formal SAML contract and Marissa will publish the cutover runbook to the shared drive link. We can book a rehearsal the week of Nov 29 if that works for your team.

Thanks,
Jordan
Senior Product Manager, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
